evidence.locator: Fig. 6; Extended Data Fig. 7a; Methods: Noise correlations and population category decoding; Results: PAC neurons do not code for category
evidence.supports: The original paper evaluates five-category linear-SVM decoding: correct load-1 maintenance trials, 80/20 trial training/testing, category balancing and 500 repetitions for session ensembles. Extended Data Fig. 7a separately tests encoding pseudo-populations and reports category-neuron accuracies of 72.77% in hippocampus and 88.71% in amygdala; these are condition-specific scores, not a universal baseline.

target.description: Original five-category neural decoding is an ordered source-paper candidate: Fig. 6 maintenance/session ensembles with intact/removed noise correlations, or the distinct Extended Data Fig. 7a encoding pseudo-populations. Select and bind one exact original task/condition before claiming a paper comparison.

dataset.description: Author NWB dataset DANDI 000673, with registration conservatively fixed to version 0.240118.2135 and source code revision a25e8cc3f61630a428f190381745257d4506f148. Later schema revisions must not silently replace it.

cohort.description: Paper source cohort is 36 patients/44 sessions, but original decoder eligibility differs by region, session, neuron ensemble and analysis. Recover the complete original selected condition roster; the Fig. 2d single-channel example is not the decoder cohort.

split.description: Fig. 6 methods train one-versus-one linear SVMs on 80% of trials and test 20%, balance five categories, and repeat 500 times; noise-removal shuffles trials within category. Extended Data Fig. 7a pseudo-populations have a distinct repetition/selection protocol. Exact original draws and selected candidate protocol remain unbound.

inputs.description: Original candidate inputs are source neuron firing rates and category labels, with correct-trial/load/region/session/ensemble restrictions appropriate to the selected source panel. Neither LFP-only Fig. 2d curves nor a newly created patient prediction task is equivalent.

preprocessing.description: Recover the chosen source panel’s spike-count window, z-scoring, category subsampling, pseudo-population construction or simultaneous-session ensemble selection, and intact/removed noise-correlation condition. Do not transfer Fig. 2d LFP preprocessing as a decoder recipe.

metric.description: Original five-category decoding accuracy is ordered higher-is-better, but the primary source condition and aggregation must be bound. Hippocampal 72.77% and amygdala 88.71% refer specifically to encoding category-neuron pseudo-populations, not the Fig. 6 maintenance condition.

aggregation.description: Fig. 6 averages repeated trial-selection decoding and assesses contributions across eligible session ensembles; Extended Data Fig. 7a summarizes separate pseudo-population repetitions. Recover the exact original score/condition and independent biological units; repetitions are not independent patients.

comparison.primary_metric: Original five-category SVM decoding accuracy for a source-matched panel/condition; selection unresolved.

published_baseline.description: Source reports 72.77% hippocampal and 88.71% amygdala accuracy for encoding category-neuron pseudo-populations. These condition-specific values are recorded as evidence only; no single scalar is admitted before choosing the matching original task, cohort and aggregation. They must not be used as Fig. 6 maintenance baselines.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No reproduced author score for the original decoding candidate is established. The existing descriptive/reference-reconstruction implementation remains calibration only and cannot supply this baseline.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful effect cannot be justified until one original decoding endpoint, its metric scale, source baseline and original sampling design are bound. No generic margin is assigned.

uncertainty.method: Recover the original evaluation units and dependence structure, then predeclare paired uncertainty for the bound original decoder comparison; no confidence threshold is invented.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Must be recovered for the chosen task: patient/session for biological generalization; pseudo-population repetitions, shuffled trials and folds are dependent.
uncertainty.rationale: Repeated folds, random subsamples, overlapping windows or decoder repetitions are not independent biological replicates. Exact original protocol and eligible units must be recovered before admission.

paper_win_requires: Select and bind one original paper decoder endpoint, including encoding versus maintenance, brain region, cell population and intact/removed-correlation condition.

Preserve the complete eligible source cohort, original 80/20 or other documented panel-specific protocol, balancing, preprocessing and aggregation; recover its matching published result and author rerun route.

Freeze candidate and meaningful effect/uncertainty/access/resource rules before final evaluation. Stronger PAC, a new patient split, an easier neuron subset or a score from another panel cannot count as this source-task win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison is claimed; any later SOTA assessment requires its own primary-source verification.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked pending recovery and binding of an ordered decoding endpoint actually evaluated in this source paper. Once admitted, iterate only with the original permitted training/validation access.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze the selected original endpoint, full cohort, source split, preprocessing, baseline route, candidate method and resource/access budgets before final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Compare on the same original source-paper task and evaluation protocol only after baseline recovery; no local descriptive reconstruction score or newly invented split can earn a paper win.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep paper-reported scores, a source-authorized author rerun, local descriptive calibration and any later SOTA comparator distinct. No original score is inferred from local numerical agreement. Where the source protocol itself uses stochastic draws, a faithful rerun may use declared provenance, a justified reproduction tolerance and paired candidate-author draws; fixed source partitions and full original condition support must remain unchanged.

blocking_issues: Which original decoding endpoint/condition is active remains unbound; encoding pseudo-population and maintenance session-ensemble results must not be conflated.
Exact eligible sessions/neurons, original split draws, preprocessing/ensemble selection and source baseline artifacts are unrecovered.
